The climate in Pomorie

Pomorie is about 2 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 1°C. Around 610 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 71 mm). The highest temperature in Pomorie in 2015–2024 was 40°C (26 July 2023) and the lowest −10°C (1 March 2018).

Pomorie is on a peninsula in the Bay of Burgas, known for Lake Pomorie and its healing mud. The climate is strongly shaped by the sea: summers are sunny and warm, the breeze eases the heat, and the sea is usually warm enough for swimming from June to mid-September.

Best time to visit Pomorie

The most pleasant weather in Pomorie is usually in June and September: average highs are between 25°C and 26°C, with up to 10 days of rain a month.
